These legal notices are governed by French law. Failing an amicable resolution, the French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.

These General Terms of Use (the “Terms of Use”) set out the terms and conditions for using the chantiertracker.com website and the ChantierTracker mobile application (together, the “Service”). Registering for or using the Service implies unreserved acceptance of these Terms of Use.
ChantierTracker enables remote construction site monitoring: the owner of a project (ADMIN role) can delegate the daily documentation of the site to a trusted person on site (SUPERVISOR role).
3. Access to the Service and account creation

Access to the Service requires the creation of an account using an email address and a password. The user undertakes to provide accurate information and to keep their login credentials confidential. The user is solely responsible for the use made of their account.
The owner of a project may invite one or more supervisors with limited rights. The owner remains solely responsible for the actions carried out by the supervisors they invite.

The publisher endeavours to ensure access to the Service 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, except in cases of force majeure, maintenance operations or breakdown. The publisher cannot be held liable for any temporary unavailability of the Service.

The publisher may suspend or terminate an account without notice in the event of a serious or repeated breach of these Terms of Use, or in the event of fraud. The user may request the deletion of their account at any time.
A PDF export of the project data is offered before termination, depending on the features included in the subscription taken out.
9. Amendment of the Terms of Use

The publisher may amend these Terms of Use at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial amendment. Continued use of the Service after an amendment constitutes acceptance of the new Terms of Use.
These Terms of Use are governed by French law.
These General Terms of Sale (the “Terms of Sale”) apply to the paid subscriptions to the Service (“Semi-Flex” and “Liberté”), as opposed to the Free plan.
Payment is made by bank card via Stripe. No bank card data is collected or stored by the publisher: payment is processed exclusively by Stripe, a PCI-DSS certified provider.
The subscription is taken out, at the customer's choice, on a monthly or annual basis, with automatic renewal unless terminated before the end of the current period.

The subscription may be terminated at any time via the Stripe management portal. Termination takes effect at the end of the period already paid; no pro rata refund is made, unless otherwise provided by law.

In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal does not apply to services fully performed before the end of the statutory withdrawal period, provided that their performance began with the consumer's prior express consent and express waiver of their right of withdrawal.\nBy subscribing to a paid plan and immediately accessing the corresponding features, the customer expressly waives their right of withdrawal for the services already performed.
A change of subscription plan is possible at any time. It is invoiced on a pro rata basis according to the rules applied by Stripe.
The publisher cannot be held liable in the event of force majeure, disruption or strike affecting the performance of the Service.

These Terms of Sale are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought in the first instance. Failing that, the consumer customer may have recourse, free of charge, to a consumer mediator. Competent mediator: {CONSUMER_MEDIATOR_DETAILS}
The controller of the personal data collected on the Site is {EDITOR_NAME}, who can be reached at the following address: {DATA_PROTECTION_CONTACT_EMAIL}.

Account data: name, email address, encrypted password.
Project data: name, location, description, financial information (budget, purchases).
Supporting photos and videos uploaded to projects, which may potentially show identifiable persons.
Billing data: managed exclusively by Stripe — no bank card data is stored by us.
Technical data: IP address, connection logs, browsing data necessary for the operation and security of the Service.

The data collected is used for: the provision and operation of the Service; billing and subscription management; security and fraud prevention; improvement of the Service (technical error monitoring); communication (sending of transactional emails).

The processing is based, as the case may be, on: the performance of the contract; consent (for non-essential cookies); legitimate interest (security); compliance with legal obligations (accounting and tax).

Account data is kept for as long as the Service is used, then for {ACCOUNT_DATA_RETENTION_DELAY} after the account is deleted, unless a longer retention period is required by law.\nThe modification history of a project is kept according to the subscription tier of its owner: 30 days for the Free plan, 6 months for the Semi-Flex plan, unlimited for the Liberté plan.

Supabase Inc. (database); Cloudflare, Inc. (photo and video storage); Stripe, Inc. (payments); Resend (sending of transactional emails); Functional Software, Inc. (Sentry — technical error monitoring, with filtering of sensitive data before sending, see section 7); Vercel Inc. and {BACKEND_HOST_DETAILS} (hosting).\nThese providers may be located outside the European Union. Any transfer of data outside the EU is governed by the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
The Service uses Sentry to detect and fix technical errors in production. Automatic filtering excludes authentication headers, cookies and sensitive data before any transmission to Sentry.

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection with regard to your data, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr). To exercise these rights, contact: {DATA_PROTECTION_CONTACT_EMAIL}.
The Service implements: password encryption; strict access control to data (Row-Level Security); encryption of communications (HTTPS); revocable token authentication.
This policy may be updated at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial amendment.

A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website, which makes it possible, in particular, to retain information about your browsing or your preferences.
2. Cookies and trackers used by the Service

As of the date of this update, the Site does not place any cookie or any other tracker (tracking technology of the localStorage type used for audience analysis, advertising or measurement purposes).\nAuthentication relies exclusively on a token mechanism stored in the local storage (localStorage) of your browser, and not on a cookie. This data is strictly necessary for the operation of the Service (keeping you logged in) and is not used for any other purpose.\nThe Site does not use any audience analytics tool or any third-party advertising or measurement tracker.

As the Service does not currently place any cookie or non-essential tracker, no consent banner is required at this stage.\nIf an audience analytics tool or another non-essential tracker were to be added to the Service, a consent banner (accept / refuse / customise) would be put in place before it is placed, and this page would be updated accordingly.

As the Site does not place any cookie, this section is not applicable to date. It will be completed if the situation changes.\n- By way of indication, an authentication token stored in localStorage is kept until logout or its technical expiry.
